He said the power source. He went on my show and he talked about a pyramid structure.
tellings.difference: Told second-hand by Michels from Corbell's appearance on his show, rather than by Corbell himself.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Corbell's claim that ODNI said Borland drew a pyramid-shaped power source in his ICIG testimony.

as_told.title: Jeremy Corbell's claim of a pyramid-shaped NHI power source drawing for ODNI

plain: A former Air Force man named Dylan Borland, who says he saw a triangle-shaped craft, gave closed testimony to the Intelligence Community Inspector General, the watchdog that takes whistleblower complaints from US spy agencies, and in it he drew a pyramid-shaped power source. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells Michels this as something he heard, citing the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp, and Michels later repeats it, crediting Corbell. If true, it would mean a witness described the engine of a craft, not just its outside.
